description: Deactivate a connected account. It stops publishing and frees a slot against the plan's account limit, but stays connected so it can be activated again without reauthorizing. CANCELS the account's scheduled posts: a deactivated account cannot publish, so every post queued against it is cancelled and its monthly quota returned, and `canceled_posts` in the response says how many. Activating the account again does NOT restore them. `scheduled_posts` in chirpie_list_accounts says beforehand how many posts this would cancel.
name: chirpie_deactivate_account
title: Deactivate an account
